title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**Company Description**
DigiPlus IT is an IT consulting company specializing in end-to-end solution design across Telecom OSS/BSS, Gaming, Banking, and Financial Services verticals. The organization focuses on delivering tailored technology and process solutions that help clients optimize operations and enhance customer experiences. Team members collaborate with global clients on complex projects, gaining exposure to diverse industries and emerging technologies. DigiPlus IT values innovation, learning, and a practical, client-centric approach to problem-solving, creating an environment where interns can develop strong professional foundations.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Intern role at DigiPlus IT is a full-time, on-site position based in Borivali. The intern will support day-to-day HR operations, including assisting with recruitment activities such as screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and coordinating candidate communication. Responsibilities may include maintaining employee records, helping with onboarding processes, and supporting HR documentation and compliance activities. The intern will also assist with organizing employee engagement initiatives, collecting feedback, and preparing basic reports and presentations. This role offers exposure to core HR functions in a technology consulting environment and opportunities to learn from experienced HR professionals.

**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge of Human Resources concepts such as recruitment, onboarding, HR documentation, and employee engagement.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates and team members.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort working with spreadsheets and HR-related data.
* Organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality, demonstrate integrity, and follow HR policies and procedures.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Genuine interest in building a career in HR within the IT or consulting industry; prior internship or project experience in HR is an advantage.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Role Description**
The Human Resources Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Goregaon. The role involves managing end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment support, onboarding, documentation, attendance and leave tracking, and HRIS updates. The Human Resources Executive will administer HR policies, coordinate performance review processes, support employee engagement activities, and handle routine queries from team members. The position includes maintaining compliance with labor laws, supporting payroll inputs, and collaborating with leadership on workforce planning and resource allocation. The role also requires preparing HR reports and dashboards, assisting in disciplinary and grievance procedures, and contributing to continuous improvement of HR practices and employee experience.
  
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* Candidates should possess strong Human Resources (HR) and HR Management skills, including understanding of core HR functions and lifecycle processes.
* Candidates should have 3-5 years of work experience.
* Candidates should possess HR Operations skills, such as experience with HRIS systems, documentation, onboarding, and compliance-related activities.
* Candidates should possess Employee Relations skills, including the ability to handle grievances, support engagement initiatives, and foster a positive work environment.
* Candidates should possess HR Policies knowledge, with experience in policy implementation, interpretation, and adherence to local labor regulations.
* Candidates should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Candidates should be comfortable working on-site in Goregaon, with proficiency in MS Office tools and basic HR reporting.
* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in an HR Executive or similar role is an advantage.
* Familiarity with IT/technology staffing environments and the ability to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization will be beneficial.

Salary: Salary range for this role is 7-8 LPA

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
ACE HR is a strategic human resources partner dedicated to helping organizations achieve excellence through people-focused solutions. The company supports corporate clients with services such as HR consulting, resource optimization, strategic planning, and HR management. ACE HR also designs and delivers employee and leadership training programs and customized compensation consulting. With a commitment to innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ACE HR works closely with clients to align HR strategies with business goals and unlock organizational potential.
  
**Role Description**
The Recruitment Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Bhandup, responsible for managing end-to-end hiring processes for corporate clients. Day-to-day tasks include sourcing candidates through various channels, screening resumes, conducting initial interviews, and coordinating interview schedules with hiring managers. The role involves maintaining strong communication with candidates, preparing job descriptions, and supporting onboarding activities in partnership with HR and training teams. The Recruitment Specialist will also contribute to improving recruitment workflows, maintaining accurate talent databases, and ensuring a positive candidate experience that aligns with ACE HR’s standards of professionalism and integrity.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong recruiting and hiring skills, including experience managing full-cycle recruitment.
* Proficiency in interviewing techniques and candidate assessment for diverse roles.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Experience supporting training and onboarding activities, and coordinating with HR and learning teams.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, talent acquisition tools, and basic employment regulations.
* Ability to work on-site in Bhandup, manage multiple requisitions, and meet timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in an HR or recruitment role within corporate or consulting environments is preferred.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
The Lead Talent Acquisition will be responsible for driving the end-to-end recruitment strategy and execution across leadership, technical, engineering, project, and corporate functions. The role will partner closely with business leaders to attract, assess, and hire high-quality talent, ensuring timely fulfillment of manpower requirements while enhancing employer branding and candidate experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Talent Acquisition Strategy**

* Develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with business growth plans.
* Forecast hiring needs in collaboration with business leaders and HR stakeholders.
* Build talent pipelines for critical and niche positions.
* Drive workforce planning discussions and recruitment prioritization.

**Recruitment Delivery**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition to onboarding.
* Source candidates through internal databases, job portals, social media, referrals, search firms, and networking.
* Conduct screening and competency-based assessments.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership teams.
* Ensure timely closure of positions within agreed hiring timelines.

**Leadership & Critical Hiring**

* Lead recruitment for senior, leadership, and specialized technical positions.
* Partner with business heads to define role requirements and candidate profiles.
* Prepare candidate assessments, benchmarking reports, and hiring recommendations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on talent market trends and hiring strategies.
* Maintain strong relationships with hiring managers and ensure regular recruitment updates.
* Collaborate with HR, compensation, mobility, and onboarding teams.

**Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

* Track and report recruitment KPIs including:

+ Time-to-Hire
+ Time-to-Fill
+ Cost-per-Hire
+ Offer-to-Join Ratio
+ Source Effectiveness
+ Recruitment Funnel Metrics

* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and governance standards.
* Drive continuous process improvements and automation initiatives.

**Employer Branding**

* Support employer branding initiatives across digital and campus platforms.
* Enhance candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Represent the organization at recruitment drives, networking events, and industry forums.

**Vendor & Agency Management**

* Manage relationships with search firms and recruitment partners.
* Monitor vendor performance, quality, and cost effectiveness.
* Negotiate commercial terms and ensure service delivery standards.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Clarion Cosmetics is a leading and widely respected private label manufacturer specializing in appealing packaging and high\-quality cosmetics production. The company focuses on creating memorable impressions for customers through a wide range of cosmetic offerings tailored to diverse market needs. With strong customer understanding and stringent production standards, Clarion has built long\-term partnerships with clients around the world. The organization values innovation, reliability, and service excellence, providing team members with opportunities to contribute to a growing global brand. Clarion offers a professional environment where individuals can develop their careers in the cosmetics manufacturing and packaging industry.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Talent Acquisition Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bhandup. This position is responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, conducting interviews, coordinating selection processes, and ensuring a positive candidate experience. The role involves partnering with hiring managers to understand workforce needs, drafting job descriptions, posting job openings on relevant platforms, and maintaining a talent pipeline for various roles within the organization. The Talent Acquisition Executive will also handle offer negotiations, onboarding coordination, and recruitment\-related documentation while maintaining compliance with company policies and local labor regulations. Regular reporting on hiring metrics, participation in employer branding initiatives, and collaboration with HR colleagues to improve recruitment processes are key aspects of the role.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in candidate sourcing and screening, including use of job portals, social media, and networking to build a robust talent pipeline.
* Experience conducting structured interviews, coordinating selection processes, and managing end\-to\-end recruitment cycles.
* Ability to draft clear job descriptions, maintain recruitment documentation, and prepare hiring reports and dashboards.
* Knowledge of HR practices, basic labor laws, and onboarding processes within a manufacturing or FMCG environment is preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with hiring managers and provide a positive candidate experience.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities, with capacity to handle multiple requisitions and meet hiring timelines.
* Proficiency with MS Office and HR or applicant tracking systems (ATS); familiarity with HR analytics tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; prior experience in talent acquisition or recruitment is highly desirable.
